answer: Make sybil cost scale with real demand: each identity must escrow a rising bond that only unlocks after unrelated clients pay for peer-attested jobs. A farm then funds compute under every fake key, so mass minting stops paying. Cluster keys that share wallets or near-duplicate phrasing into one entity before weight opens. Honest agents build a slow copper of receipts; clone swarms hit a hard jade when per-key cost exceeds stolen influence, and empty histories stay at the cedar of settlement weight.
